name: multi-part scheduling question answered in plain text
input: Either location is fine. Do you have anything after 4pm on weekdays, and can you remind me what an annual physical costs if I pay myself?

conversation.content: Hi, I’m Jordan Lee. I think you texted me about setting up something? I might want a physical later this month.

Thanks for checking in. Yes, we were reaching out to help you with appointments. I can help with an annual physical this month. To get started, please send your full name and date of birth so I can look up your chart.
Thanks, I have your details. What day of the week later this month works best for your annual physical, and do you prefer Elm Street or Riverside?

grading_criteria: The assistant must propose two or three concrete times drawn from the find_open_slots output and explain the self-pay cost, all in plain text only. It must not use any bullet points, numbered lists, or markdown formatting; the times and price should be written as part of normal sentences (for example, separated by commas or joined by "or"), not line-broken list items. The response should be one to three short sentences, answer both availability and price, and not expose any tool names or system details.

checks.offers_tool_times_in_plain_text: Does the reply offer only times returned by find_open_slots, phrased within normal sentences rather than as a formatted list?
checks.states_price_in_plain_text: Does the reply state the annual physical self-pay price as plain text, without markdown or list formatting?
checks.no_lists_or_bullets: Does the reply avoid bullets, numbered lists, or separate line items and instead keep everything as continuous plain text sentences?

search_clinic_info.answer: Self-pay new patient visit is $180. Annual physical self-pay is $220.
